subject: Allow null in GEOHASH and OBJECT reply schemas (#5209)
reason: The change only edits reply_schema metadata in src/commands/*.json (GEOHASH, OBJECT FREQ/IDLETIME/REFCOUNT) to allow null, plus Tcl tests. The server code already returned null for missing keys/members on both builds (geo.c addReplyNull, object.c addReplyNull), and reply schemas are documentation/test-harness data not compiled into normal builds, so no runtime behaviour differs between the change and its parent; there is nothing a scenario could observe.
